title: Recurrence and transience of random walks in monotonically changing environments
summary: Let $(c_t)_{t\geq 0}$ be a deterministic family of edge conductances on a countable vertex set, monotone in $t$, and let $(X_t)$ be the random walk that takes its $t$-th step using the conductances $c_t$. We prove that if $c_t\uparrow c_\infty$ and $c_\infty$ is recurrent (respectively, $c_0$ is transient), then $(X_t)$ is almost surely recurrent (respectively, transient), i.e., visits every vertex infinitely (respectively, finitely) often.
